title: A Chicago prairie smoke
done: You made prairie smoke! It gets its name from the long, feathery tails on its seeds. It grows in northern Illinois.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table. It is the stem.
Put another green square on top.
Put a small green triangle on the left of the stem. A leaf.
Put a small green triangle on the right of the stem.
Put a tall purple triangle on top of the stem. A wispy tail! Real ones are pink; we use purple.
Put another tall purple triangle on the left.
Put another on the right. Now it looks like smoke.
